envelope.description: Reserve checkpoint capacity before provider dispatch

body.title: Reserve checkpoint capacity before provider dispatch
body.summary: Add shared serializer-based bounded reservations before planning, impact, chunk and retry dispatch. Include accepted response, report duplication, aggregate arrays, history and bounded terminal metadata; preserve the fixed checkpoint ceiling.
acceptanceChecks: Exact-bound maximum valid responses persist and consolidate across restart; one-over refuses durably with zero provider calls.

Bound host-added diagnostics and all reservation fields. A checkpoint-capacity refusal is a durable pre-dispatch failure with no model/retry expenditure; end-to-end publication-only capacity retry is implemented and proven by t4, not a prerequisite for t2.

tests.name: I8 exact-byte dispatch reservations, consolidation duplication, refusal and restart
